Raster to pen path — method reference

Plotter Method Specimens

Every vectorization method in this repository, run on one photograph and one tone ramp, at identical canvas and pen. Any difference you see belongs to the method. The ramp is the useful half: with no subject to distract, it shows exactly how a method turns tone into marks — and where its thresholds fall.
